authorization: User requested real native chat SDK integration on 2026-11-13
compatibility: Declared server version is repository evidence; production interoperability remains an account/device verification gate.

token.policy: Request once for a real SDK login; reuse while valid; do not loop token issuance on resource-not-ready or transport reconnect.

endpoints.upgrade_policy: Only for the exact default existing business origin, upgrade exact legacy host/default port/path endpoints to existing public HTTPS/WSS origin; explicit default port and a single trailing slash may normalize to the same endpoint. Reject userinfo, query, fragment and unrelated cleartext hosts. Secure explicit server endpoints remain supported. Do not disable TLS verification.

first_real_chat_slice: SDK initialization and login with environment/account isolated private directories
paginated real conversations and stable IDs
history by clientMsgID cursor; errors are not end-of-history
text create/send and incoming message events
single session type 1 and supergroup session type 3 routing
separate connection/store/sync status; account generation and sync attempt isolation
persistent own outbox separate from SDK private tables; uncertain results must not auto-resend
logout invalidates callbacks and credentials without deleting account databases
delivery_policy: SDK send acceptance is not recipient delivery or read receipt. Do not display synthetic delivered/read indicators.
unsupported_messages: Media/custom/system types require explicit readable summaries and must not be rendered as text or exposed as raw JSON. Rich rendering and business action handling need separate parity work.
